decisions.rationale: 'atherosclerosis' names one specific arterial disease with a single definition and no further subcategorization, so it is a Specific Disease rather than a Disease Class.

decisions.rationale: 'CETP deficiency' is a specific inherited disorder identified by a single defined cause (CETP deficiency). The head word 'deficiency' is general on its own, but the full span denotes one specific disease, as with 'C7 deficiency' in Example 6.
